Metadata.title: OFM 2027 — Francophone Mathematical Olympiad · organised from Dakar
Metadata.description: The 2027 Francophone Mathematical Olympiad brings together, online, the best young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, around exams selected by a committee appointed by the host country. Organised by Terangamath (Dakar, Senegal).

About.title: About the OFM
About.p1: The Francophone Mathematical Olympiad is a competition for students across the French-speaking world. It sets problems in algebra, combinatorics, geometry and number theory, in two categories: Junior and Senior.
About.p2: Participants represent their country in national delegations. Each paper consists of four problems to be solved in four and a half hours.
About.p3: The 8th edition is organised by Terangamath in Senegal on 27 and 28 March 2027, with papers sat remotely in the participating countries.
About.logoAlt: OFM 2027 logo: the letter π in the colours of Senegal, a baobab and a pirogue, above “OFM 2027 Sénégal, Olympiades francophones de mathématiques”.

Olympiad.title: The Francophone Mathematical Olympiad
Olympiad.lead: A competition of excellence for young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, led for the 2027 edition by the Terangamath association.

Presentation.title: A competition of excellence, a spirit of hospitality
Presentation.body1: Each year, OFM brings together the best young mathematicians from French-speaking countries, in two age categories, around original mathematics exams, designed to reveal reasoning as much as technique.
Presentation.body2: The 2027 edition is led from Dakar by Terangamath, a Senegalese association dedicated to promoting mathematics, with the ambition of combining scientific rigour with Senegalese hospitality — the Teranga.

Format.title: The exam format
Format.lead: A fully online competition, in the OFM tradition. The details below follow the Olympiad's general rule; Terangamath will confirm them for the 2027 edition.

Organisation.title: Terangamath & the organisation of OFM 2027
Organisation.lead: The Olympiad is led by the Terangamath association, supported by committees dedicated to problem selection and to the coordination of marking.

About.title: The organising association
About.body: Terangamath is the Senegalese association behind OFM 2027. Its name draws on the Teranga, Senegalese hospitality, which it puts to work promoting mathematics among young people across the French-speaking world.
